organic.instructions: Based only on the dossier facts, is this move organic?

criteria.true: Holders are growing because of many independent buyers, not one wallet walking the price up.
criteria.false: The move is driven by one or a few wallets walking the price up, or organic growth is not supported by the facts.

late.instructions: Based only on the dossier facts, is this lead late?

criteria.true: Most of the move already happened before this lead reached the desk.
criteria.false: Most of the move has not yet happened; the lead reached the desk early.

exit_risk.instructions: Rate exit risk for our position size (our_size_usd) against the pool liquidity.
criteria: 1: deep liquidity, our size is negligible
2: good liquidity, our size is small
3: moderate liquidity, our size is noticeable
4: thin liquidity, our size is a meaningful share
5: our size is a big part of the pool

action.instructions: Based only on the dossier facts, what should a paper desk do with this lead?

criteria.buy: Facts support a paper buy now.
criteria.watch: Facts are promising but incomplete; re-check later.
criteria.pass: Facts do not support a buy.
